clue.text: Before wonderful short building

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
fab is informal short for fabulous, wonderful

explanation.surface: Something placed in front of a wonderfully stubby building.
explanation.definitionFit: A prefab is the shortened name for a prefabricated house, a quickly assembled structure.

clue.text: Gave up work and went to bed

definitions.meaning: stopped working at the end of a career

explanation.definitionFit: Retiring means both leaving employment for good and going to bed for the night.

clue.text: Fail, perhaps, absorbing nitrogen last

indicators.note: absorbing means the jumbled letters take another piece inside them
perhaps suggests the letters of fail could be arranged another way

parts.note: N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A failure that soaks up nitrogen at the very end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' turns FAIL into FIAL, and 'absorbing' puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Final and last are synonyms, both meaning coming at the end.

clue.text: Something to press, though not the wrong way!

parts.note: but and though both introduce a contrast

indicators.note: the wrong way means the word not is read backwards

explanation.surface: A warning about which way to press something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong way' turns NOT into TON.
explanation.definitionFit: A button is a small control you push to operate a machine.

clue.text: Change egg supplier, though not originally

indicators.note: not originally means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: the ovary is the organ that produces eggs

explanation.surface: Switch to a different egg supplier, as opposed to the first one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not originally' drops the O from OVARY; the surface's farmer selling eggs is a decoy.
explanation.definitionFit: To vary is to alter or modify, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Cool van travelling to hot mountain

indicators.note: travelling suggests the letters of cool van move around

explanation.surface: A chilled van journeys to a sweltering peak.
explanation.definitionFit: A volcano is a mountain that erupts lava, so it is literally hot.

clue.text: Wandered and drove about

indicators.note: about suggests the letters of drove are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone meandered and drove around.
explanation.definitionFit: Roving is wandering without fixed direction, so the past tenses are synonyms.

clue.text: Penny contributions, or where they are held?

parts.note: alms are charitable gifts to the poor

explanation.surface: Small coin donations and the hands that hold them out.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the hands: alms are received into open hands.
explanation.definitionFit: Charity given is held in the hollow of the hands, so the definition is a playful description.

clue.text: Frank makes six deliveries on time

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled

explanation.surface: A bowler named Frank sends down his over punctually.
explanation.walkthrough: Frank looks like a name; it is the definition. In cricket an OVER is six balls bowled by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank and overt both describe something open and not concealed.

clue.text: Part of Glastonbury or part of Birmingham

indicators.note: part of means the letters lie inside the word Glastonbury

explanation.surface: A question of which place fragment comes from which town.
explanation.walkthrough: Glastonbury is an English town famous for its music festival; Aston is a district of Birmingham, England's second city.
explanation.definitionFit: Aston is a named inner-city district of Birmingham.

clue.text: A live TV broadcast for Israeli city

indicators.note: broadcast suggests the letters are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A live television transmission from a city in Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: Tel Aviv is a major coastal city in Israel.

clue.text: Extra toppings of lemon, lime, orange and cherry

parts.note: more means extra or additional

indicators.note: toppings of means the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A dessert with extra citrus garnishes and a cherry on top.
explanation.definitionFit: The morello is a variety of sour dark cherry.

clue.text: Dread variety of European snake

indicators.note: variety of suggests a different arrangement of the letters of dread

explanation.surface: A frightening kind of snake found in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The adder is the common viper of Europe, Britain's only venomous snake.

clue.text: Cited new decree

indicators.note: new suggests the letters of cited are made into a fresh word

explanation.surface: A recently issued order quoted by someone.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official order issued by an authority.

clue.text: Stopped snatching third of cards, and folded

indicators.note: snatching means the word grabs a letter and holds it inside

parts.note: ceased means stopped

indicators.note: third of means the third letter of the word cards

explanation.surface: A card game was halted after someone grabbed cards, and they folded.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper that has been folded carries a crease, so creased is a synonym.

clue.text: Half tilts the French SI unit

indicators.note: half means the first three of the six letters are kept

parts.note: to tilt is to joust with a lance
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Half of something tips the French measurement.
explanation.walkthrough: To tilt is to charge with a lance, so tilts gives JOUSTS, halved to JOU.
explanation.definitionFit: The joule is the standard international unit of energy.

clue.text: In the future a header for Liverpool on side

parts.note: later means at a future time

indicators.note: header for means the first letter of Liverpool

explanation.surface: A football header for Liverpool in the future, on the wing.
explanation.walkthrough: The football header is a decoy; 'header for' just takes L.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral means situated at or relating to the side.

clue.text: Regal sort of composer

indicators.note: sort of suggests the letters of regal are sorted into another order

explanation.surface: A kind of royal music-maker.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar was an English composer, known for the Enigma Variations.

clue.text: Nick is on after Peter, gutted

indicators.note: after means the words is on come behind the other piece
gutted means the insides of Peter are removed, leaving the outer letters

explanation.surface: Peter is devastated, now in the nick.
explanation.walkthrough: Nick is British slang for prison; 'gutted' (Peter's middle removed) gives PR.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang the nick is a prison or police station.

clue.text: Groom about to be put in prison

indicators.note: to be put in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: pen is slang for a penitentiary, a prison
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A bridegroom about to be locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: Groom is the verb, to tidy oneself, not a bridegroom.
explanation.definitionFit: To preen is to groom oneself carefully, as a bird does its feathers.

clue.text: Cotton thread left on offshore land

parts.note: an isle is an island

explanation.surface: Thread abandoned on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle is a fine, smooth cotton thread used in stockings.

clue.text: Small body of water to satisfy

parts.note: a lake is an inland body of water

explanation.surface: A little pond is enough to meet needs.
explanation.definitionFit: To slake a thirst is to quench or satisfy it.

clue.text: This goes up and down and round and round

definitions.text: This goes up and down and round and round

parts.words: This goes up and down and round and round
parts.note: the word reads the same up or down a grid, and names a thing that spins

explanation.surface: A riddle about something that bobs and spins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up and down' hints that the word reads the same both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotator is any device or muscle that turns things round.

clue.text: Gamble after it returned to Himalayan region

indicators.note: after means the gamble comes behind the other piece
returned means the word it is read backwards

parts.note: a bet is a gamble

explanation.surface: Someone places a wager after it comes back from the Himalayas.
explanation.definitionFit: Tibet is a high plateau region in the Himalayas, now part of China.

clue.text: Assembles article on church services

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
masses are Catholic services of communion

explanation.surface: A newspaper article about church services.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to gather or collect together, as assembles does.

clue.text: Bump into the vessel

definitions.meaning: to ... into is to collide with roughly
a flat-bottomed boat for carrying cargo on canals

explanation.definitionFit: Barging means pushing clumsily into someone; a barge is also a canal boat.

clue.text: Geek appears during dinner date

indicators.note: appears during means the letters show up within the words dinner date

explanation.surface: A geeky person turns up on a dinner date.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerd and geek are both informal words for a socially awkward enthusiast.

clue.text: Catch let loose, which stings

parts.note: to net is to catch

indicators.note: loose suggests the letters of let are set free into another order

explanation.surface: Catching something, then letting go of a stinging creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A nettle is a plant with stinging hairs on its leaves.
